name: VIOLET-WHITE Half Marathon 2026
short_description: VIOLET-WHITE Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 4 October 2026 at Wat Muang Khao Kaeo Phikun in Si Mahosot, Prachin Buri, over 5 km, 10.5 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: VIOLET-WHITE Half Marathon 2026 is the third edition of the race, organised by Pre-Running and based at Wat Muang Khao Kaeo Phikun in Khok Pip, Si Mahosot district, Prachin Buri. The 21 km starts at 05:00, the 10.5 km at 05:30 and the 5 km at 05:45. Overall winners of the 21 km receive prize money of THB 3,000, 2,000 and 1,000, and 21 km finishers receive a finisher shirt.

core_facts.venue: Wat Muang Khao Kaeo Phikun, Khok Pip

faqs.question: How much does the VIOLET-WHITE Half Marathon 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: The registration page lists the 21 km at THB 700, the 10.5 km at THB 600 and the 5 km at THB 500. VIP entries in each distance cost THB 2,000 and include an engraved 55 cm trophy, and a family team of three over 5 km costs THB 1,500.

faqs.question: When and where is race pack collection for the VIOLET-WHITE Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Race packs are collected on Saturday 3 October 2026 from 10:00 to 21:00 at Wat Muang Khao Kaeo Phikun. Postal delivery within Thailand can be chosen at registration for THB 60 per runner.
